differences.finding: Direction indices/vectors, integer projection/picking and all 60 pattern/16 support definitions retained. Direction display names are Japanese; host drawing namespaces changed.
Construction 6000000 * (height<0 ? -2*height : height+1), height=z-ground. Removal 2000000 * count * (abs(endZ-water)+1). Long quote/aggregate; individual int products still need overflow decisions.
Construction 40000000 * (height<0 ? -2*height : height+1), height=baseZ-water; removal 8000000*(abs(baseZ+1-water)+1). Eight-cell legality and slope frame/z-transition geometry retained.

New build/removal accounting and occupied TrainCar removal guards. Bridge/girder precharge entire inclusive route even when occupied cells are skipped; tunnel charges only created/removed cells and still excludes final removal endpoint. Preserve as source differences pending portable transaction decisions.

-999 forwards without reversal, -1000 reverses and forwards; other negative waits reverse. Yard departure rings bell but skips boarding for either sentinel. Outside counter 50 unloads but skips reload while forwarding.

Movement charges on successful movements 1,5,9,...: (length*20+passenger/20)*2000. Fare r*fare*distance*2. Seated capacity falls back per car when invalid, packed capacity = seated+2*(capacity-seated). Reverse wrapper copies seated capacity. Sale returns price/(wholeYears+2) only with boughtTime.

First placement uses native interval. At callback completion Inside->Inside uses pre-move head location (also on blocked retry); exit and outside-return use native interval. Low always 4; medium native only if exactly 4 else 3; fast native only if exactly 3/4 else 2. This is not a generic max(native,limit). Priority low,medium,fast if malformed lists overlap.

Both host ranges now 8. Thin roof optional, middle indices length/4 <= i < length-length/4; fat constructor resets only its local withRoof argument, no new roof drawing. Concrete/brown/green passageway and stair arrays; changed drawAfter overload no longer overrides ordinary two-argument RailRoad.drawAfter.

Tick/queue order and minute/calendar constants retained. Clock adds shallow Clone, Time adds gameStartTime, fixed holiday/vacation predicates and Japanese weekday/display strings; TimeLength adds integer division. PriorityQueue.setValueComparer now assigns vc; callback cancellation issue remains.

Car pose/frame and six traffic passes retained. SimpleSprite blits _size. Station labels use configured fonts/colors; recursive train labels render afterwards only for Inside heads, offset Y=-8. Catalog preview searches 5,6..17,4..1; it is not a movement oracle. AbstractLineController cost display calls road helpers even for special rail; must not be used as authoritative rail quote.
Occupied signal removal rejects any car; source pass-predicate inversion retained.
